gloss: to bundle, to tie together; to lead, to unite

definitions.gloss: to bundle, to tie together, to gather into a bunch
definitions.explanation: To collect loose items and bind them together into a single bundle or bunch. Used for physical objects like hair, flowers, documents, or sticks.

definitions.gloss: to lead, to unite, to bring together (people or groups)
definitions.explanation: To organize and lead a group of people, or to bring diverse individuals or factions together under unified direction.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}をひもで{束|たば}ねた。
examples.english: I bundled the newspapers with string.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}を{束|たば}ねてリボンで{結|むす}び、{花束|はなたば}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I gathered the flowers together, tied them with a ribbon, and made a bouquet.

examples.japanese: チームを{束|たば}ねる{力|ちから}がある。
examples.english: To have the ability to lead a team.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}が{部門|ぶもん}{全体|ぜんたい}を{束|たば}ねている。
{意見|いけん}の{異|こと}なるメンバーを{束|たば}ねて、{一|ひと}つのプロジェクトを{完成|かんせい}させた。
examples.english: I brought together members with differing opinions and completed the project.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: {束|たば}ねない
- Polite: {束|たば}ねます
- Te-form: {束|たば}ねて
- Past: {束|たば}ねた

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪|かみ}を{束|たば}ねる: to tie up hair
- {新聞|しんぶん}を{束|たば}ねる: to bundle newspapers
- チームを{束|たば}ねる: to lead/unite a team
- {組織|そしき}を{束|たば}ねる: to lead an organization

NOTE:
The related noun {束|たば} means "bundle" or "bunch" (e.g., {花束|はなたば} "bouquet," {札束|さつたば} "wad of bills").
